title: Disruptive Mood Dysregulation Disorder (DMDD) and Intense Anger Outbursts
summary: DMDD: Severe verbal/behavioral anger outbursts >3 times weekly, irritable/angry mood nearly daily, for >12 months, in at least two settings (home/school). It is not defiance—it is a mood disorder requiring treatment. Approach: Accurate diagnosis (ruling out bipolar/ADHD/depression), family behavioral therapy, emotion-regulation skills, and medication if needed. Parents: Do not blame; seek a specialist’s diagnosis.
try_this: This week: Record the anger outbursts (when, trigger, duration, intensity 1-10)—a week’s data will help the doctor make an accurate diagnosis.
reflection_prompts: How many outbursts were recorded this week?
